description: This file contains unit tests for the ServerManagerModuleService, specifically testing various session server state transitions, configuration, logging, and ping functionalities within the Rialto media server component.

methods.name: shouldSetConfiguration
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the configuration to ACTIVE.

methods.name: shouldSetStateToUninitialized
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the state to UNINITIALIZED.

methods.name: shouldSetStateToInactive
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the state to INACTIVE.

methods.name: shouldSetStateToActive
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the state to ACTIVE.

methods.name: shouldSetStateToNotRunning
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the state to NOT_RUNNING.

methods.name: shouldSetStateToError
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting the state to ERROR.

methods.name: shouldSetLogLevels
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles setting log levels.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetConfiguration
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles failure when setting configuration.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetState
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles failure when setting state.

methods.name: shouldPing
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles a ping request.

methods.name: shouldFailToPing
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles a failed ping request.

methods.name: shouldFailToPingDueToInvalidController
methods.description: Test that the server manager correctly handles a ping request failure due to invalid controller.
